brief:
Israeli forces violated the ceasefire agreement in the Gaza Strip on Wednesday while maintaining and tightening a blockade on the coastal enclave, IMEMC News reported. The breaches marked the 328th consecutive day of violations since the ceasefire took effect, with no sign of abatement in military operations across the territory.

The intensified siege has severely restricted the movement of humanitarian aid and essential supplies into Gaza, compounding an acute shortage of food, medicine, and fuel. Aid organizations have warned that the combined effect of ceasefire violations and blockade enforcement is deepening a humanitarian catastrophe affecting hundreds of thousands of Palestinians trapped in the enclave with limited access to basic necessities.

title: Israeli forces breach Gaza ceasefire for 328th consecutive day
